overview: The Community Development Board granted a special permit for an auto glass business, approved a site plan review for a research and testing facility on Commercial Street, and discussed ongoing efforts surrounding the comprehensive zoning overhaul.

items.title: 290 Salem Street Continuance
items.summary: Continued the hearing for 290 Salem Street to April 17, 2024, at the applicant's request.

items.title: Special Permit: 294 Harvard Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to establish an auto glass repair business within an existing building, subject to conditions regarding barbed wire removal, fence screening, signage review, and parking striping.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 48-64 Commercial Street
items.summary: Approved the site plan review to construct a two-story, 97,857-square-foot research and testing lab, conditioned on concrete driveway aprons, plan revisions per the traffic director's memo regarding Commercial Street curbing, and wayfinding signage to the adjacent plaza.

items.title: Approval of Minutes: March 13, 2024
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from March 13, 2024.

items.title: City Zoning Overhaul Updates
items.summary: Planning staff provided an update on the citywide zoning recodification process, outlining short-term goals such as updating archaic use definitions, adding uses like coffee shops, consolidating parking tables, and clarifying usable open space requirements.
